tag.vi: 🦶 Làm chân: "gót chân tôi thô quá"

occasion: You stand all day at work and your heels are dry, rough and a little cracked. You are a bit embarrassed about it.
constraints: You want a pedicure that really takes care of the rough heels: you ask about callus removal (callus treatment is an add-on on the menu) and whether it hurts. A clean, natural colour. You relax when the stylist is kind about your feet and explains the scrub and the callus care; you feel worse if she makes a face or rushes.
openingLine: Hi... I need a pedicure. My heels are so rough, I'm a little embarrassed. Can you do something about the calluses?
